prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 14 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1057; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the forces involved in a collision of this type, and the presenting symptoms are plausible given that history. Over the course of 14 visits, care included physical examination, a structured rehabilitation program, and activity modification. Treatment followed a typical clinical progression, with visit frequency decreasing as strength and mobility improved. Imaging and clinical examination findings clearly confirm the shoulder injury. No prior injury or treatment involving the same body area is known to this provider. Administrative review of two similar billing entries recorded on the same date of service is currently in progress. Based on the patient's response to care, the provider anticipates continued gradual recovery with a home exercise program and periodic reassessment as needed.
